scope_and_status_rules: Full parity targets the pinned documented implementation; promises of future physics in the 2025 papers are not already implemented requirements.
The requirement, option and public-method inventories overlap; do not add their counts or compute an overall completion percentage.
Implementation, native tests, MATLAB agreement, physical consistency and experimental comparison are separate axes.
passed_scoped refers only to cited cases and criteria. It does not mean the whole requirement or operating range is closed.
A declared enum or matching method name is not a branch test or numerical reference comparison.
Dependencies apply to acceptance of the relevant subcase. They do not prevent exploratory execution, investigation, or independent work on other cases.
Preserve governing equations and original core tolerances. Diagnose translation errors separately from intentional approximations, source defects and calibration choices.
